```{r}
library(limma)
leduc_test <- getWithColData(leduc, "proteins_norm")
assay(leduc_test) <- limma::removeBatchEffect(x = assay(leduc[["proteins_norm"]]), batch = leduc$lcbatch)


compDistr(object = leduc_test,covariate = "SampleType", adjust = F, robust = F) %>% rowData
assays(compDistr(object = leduc, i = "proteins_norm" ,covariate = "SampleType", 
                 adjust = F, nuisance = ~lcbatch, robust = F)[["proteins_norm"]])$assay_partialresiduals[1:10,1:10]
assay(leduc_test)[1:10,1:10]
```
